svg.text: STAGE 528 · TOPIC 168 · P1049–P1050 🎉 · 🎉 HISTORIC P1050, 170TH FAQ & 970-TEST TRIPLE MILESTONE!
Enterprise WebRTC/RTP RFC 3389 Comfort Noise (CN) 0 dBov Blast & Opus DTX Exclusivity
Deterministic [45, 90] -dBov Attenuation Floor (P1049) & RFC 7587 Opus vs. CN Exclusivity + [100, 400]ms SID Keepalive (P1050 🎉)
❌ UNPROTECTED RFC 3389 COMFORT NOISE
1. Byte-0 Sign Inversion: N=0..3 (-3 dBov) Noise Bomb
RTP PT=13 CN Byte0=0x03 -> Power = -3 dBov (Full-Scale Blast!)
• 15 CN packets with N < 45 blast white noise into user headsets
• Trips AI Voice Agent VAD into false barge-in self-interruption
2. Opus (48kHz) + External CN (8kHz) Clock Tear
SSRC mixes PT=111 (Opus/48000) & PT=13 (CN/8000) ❌
• 21 clock-clash CN packets corrupt NetEQ RTP timestamp stride
• 2500ms SID gaps trigger NAT expiration & ASR NoAudioTimeout
Production Impact Without P1049 / P1050 🎉
• Deafening white-noise bursts during caller silence intervals
• NetEQ jitter buffer resets & false AI Agent barge-in cutoffs
✅ STAGE 528 DETERMINISTIC GUARDRAILS (P1049–P1050 🎉)
P1049 (1,058th Guard): [45, 90] -dBov CN Floor & LPC Order
action: "clamp_rfc3389_cn_attenuation_dbov_and_drop_blast_packets"
• Blocks N < 45 noise bombs & validates LPC order M in [0, 12]
• Clamps whiteNoiseBlastOrUnstableFilterPackets = 0
• Clamps comfortNoiseAttenuationDbov in [45, 90] (3 -> 45 -dBov)
Policy ID: P1049-WEBRTC-RFC3389-COMFORT-NOISE-LEVEL-ATTENUATION-AND-MODEL-ORDER-GUARD
P1050 🎉 (170th FAQ & 970 Tests 🎉): Opus vs CN & [100, 400]ms SID
action: "strip_external_cn_from_opus_and_clamp_sid_keepalive_ms"
• Enforces RFC 7587 §6.1 Opus vs. RFC 3389 CN mutual exclusivity
• Clamps opusRfc3389CnClockClashPackets = 0
• Clamps sidComfortNoiseKeepaliveIntervalMs in [100, 400]ms (2500 -> 400ms)
Policy ID: P1050-WEBRTC-RFC3389-OPUS-DTX-MUTUAL-EXCLUSIVITY-AND-SID-KEEPALIVE-INTERVAL-GUARD
